slice.candidate: Immutable role-local checkpoint plus one mutable LATEST pointer updated by contents-API blob-SHA CAS, with deterministic idempotency/predecessor fields and exact readback.

public_primary_evidence.source: GitHub REST API documentation: repository contents create/update endpoint
public_primary_evidence.observed: Updating a file requires the SHA of the blob being replaced; 409 Conflict is a documented response; create/update and delete operations that race should be serialized.

slice.current_capability_probe: The scheduled-Chat GitHub contents connector exposes create_file plus update_file requiring the current file SHA. This invocation uses that authorized role-local path to create this immutable checkpoint, then CAS-update LATEST and exact-read back; no hosted runner or richer execution mode is used.

A_single_path_cas_checkpoint_pointer.conflict_duplication_risk: low when checkpoint is created first and LATEST is the only mutable CAS pointer
A_single_path_cas_checkpoint_pointer.quota_fragility: low with respect to monthly/trial/paid quotas; subject to ordinary repository API rate limits, which are transport interruptions rather than accepted compute

B_git_ref_plumbing.conflict_duplication_risk: medium because extra object/ref plumbing and force semantics must be controlled
B_git_ref_plumbing.quota_fragility: low-monthly but same repository transport limits

C_append_only_issue_or_comment_log.conflict_duplication_risk: medium-high because append order alone does not provide a single current-state CAS pointer
C_append_only_issue_or_comment_log.quota_fragility: low-monthly but same repository transport limits

slice.falsification_result: Not falsified for the tested narrow property: a contents-backed immutable-checkpoint + mutable-pointer protocol has documented per-file optimistic concurrency primitives and can be exercised entirely through scheduled Chat repository transport. It does not provide multi-file atomicity and does not eliminate repository-transport availability/rate-limit dependence.
slice.scope_limit: This verifies only a role-local per-path persistence/conflict/idempotency architecture. It does not prove full richer-mode outcome parity, multi-file transactions, unlimited API availability, or 19-role integration.

phase1_assessment.accepted_route_scope: candidate mechanism remains zero-cost and zero-monthly-quota within the tested repository-transport scope; ordinary API rate limits remain a recoverable transport interruption and must not be used as compute
phase1_assessment.conflict_check: Only frozen sanitized controls, own cross_field state, current role-local connector capability, and public GitHub documentation were used; no O/O-derived, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, or other-role semantics were consumed.

frontier: Test crash safety of checkpoint-first/pointer-last ordering under an interrupted or stale-pointer update without adding a second mutable authority file.
Compare whether deterministic create-if-absent idempotency keys can make duplicate retries distinguish existing-success from conflicting-different-content without a richer executor.
Preserve multi-file atomicity as an unresolved child; do not generalize single-path CAS into transaction semantics.
exact_next_action: On the next invocation, execute exactly one bounded self-contained fault-injection/model-check leaf for checkpoint-first then CAS-pointer-last ordering: enumerate success, duplicate retry, stale pointer, and interruption-between-writes traces and verify whether every trace reconstructs either the old committed state or the new committed state without duplicate semantic effect; checkpoint any counterexample and keep multi-file atomicity unresolved.
